chapter: Opinions on pop music, jazz education and the business
title: Tiny Tim on television
summary: Wilson, Hinton and Ted Jr. recall Tiny Tim's rise, Ted Jr. having seen him in the subway, and his televised wedding.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: But I still say -- we've talked a lot about these trends and all this stuff, but you can't pin the business down because tomorrow another Tiny Tim might come out and sweep everybody away! You have to hear it to believe it. You've heard Tiptoe Through The Tulips, Ted, didn't you?
Yeah, I told you that I saw
him two months before in the subway, oh yeah.
Steven, we've got to get you the record -- you've got to hear it.
Oh, you've got to hear it!
Oh, no, it's not so much hearing it; you had to see it on Ed Sullivan to hear and see him.
He got married on television, I think.
Yes, right -- to Miss, what was her name? But she threw him out after awhile, or he threw her out, one of the two.
